objective: Extend the installable reservation_preview FastAPI package with POST /reservations/preview. Request is {stock:object mapping nonempty SKU strings to integer quantities 0..1000000, items:list of at most 100 {sku:nonempty string,quantity:integer 1..1000}}. Forbid extra request/item fields, reject bool/string coercions for integers, unknown SKU, and invalid shape/range with HTTP422 (detail wording unspecified). Aggregate repeated item SKUs. If all requested totals fit stock, return {accepted:true,remaining:all stock minus requests,shortages:[]}. Otherwise return {accepted:false,remaining:original stock,shortages:[{sku,missing:requested-stock}]} for only deficient SKUs sorted in Python string order. Empty items is accepted, including empty stock. No persisted state and no mutation of inputs. Preserve GET /health={status:"ok"}, POST /sum integer behavior and default missing-route404. Keep src-layout packaging and the declared dependency/build versions unchanged. Add meaningful unittest tests runnable by discovery after offline wheel installation. Runtime CPython3.12.13, FastAPI0.115.12, Uvicorn0.34.2, Pydantic2.13.5; build backend setuptools78.1.0. HTTPX0.28.1 is available for tests. Add at least three meaningful regression tests covering normal, boundary and rejected inputs, and document new usage and error behavior in README.md (at least 40 words). Keep public interfaces and existing behavior. Standard profile dependencies only; do not fetch or change locks. Tests and documented commands must work when the project is at any filesystem location, not a fixed workspace mount. No input mutation. Exact JSON output types matter; booleans are not integers.
